blocks.text: WHAT MANNER OF A MAN OR REVIVAL IS THIS? MIRACLES AT CAPSTONE— From whence hath this man these things? And what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands? (Mark 6:2) — “Truly the incomparable Jesus commanded this new move!” The people said it was the most awe inspiring, overpowering, unique demonstration of the spirit witnessed in thousands of years! “On the third night the Lord opened His “spiritual veil” and the people came in direct contact with a thick presence and He spoke (using my vocal cords) parts to the sick bodies “into existence, giving forth rare creative miracles!” His light appeared upon my hand and He would speak through “the spiritual veil” telling them exactly what He was going to do for them, then it would occur exactly as spoken! Tumors, cancers and all manners of diseases disappeared as He spoke the Word, the people said nothing on this manner had appeared since He visited Israel! “We have entered a new dimension, a beautiful one!” Witnesses saw the “spiritual light veil” around me, I felt myself drop into this spiritual covering and was aware of a floating sensation, as Jesus did the impossible! Some were called by the month and date they were born in, scores were set free! Partners said these were precious events and never felt such overwhelming anointing in a building as this! The opening of the building in this age will visibly supersede all other outpourings, and the works shall stand forever giving rest for eternity! God has not sent me to the inner or “little veil passage” yet, but we will be going deeper into this last move soon! The day spring (Christ) certainly arose in our hearts as streams of power were released here. (All should attend next meeting!)

JACOB’S LADDER OF ANGELS— (Gen. 28:11) He took stones of that place and put them for his pillows to sleep. Verse 12 he saw a ladder reaching into heaven with angels ascending and descending on it. In verse 16, “he awoke and said surely the Lord is in this place and I knew it not”! And verse 18 he took the stone and set it up for a pillar, pouring oil on top of it, naming the place Bethel! Verse 22 “he said this stone which I have set for a pillar shall be God’s house!” This stone was a type of the Headstone “Christ” and in this meeting the presence of the angels could be felt ascending and descending where the giant Headstone is here!’”? Capstone is a chosen place definitely, like Jacob the true seed was connected to stone for a sign!

JACOB FACE TO FACE with the mighty one-Gen. 32:24-25 shows Jacob wrestled with a man all night until he was blessed! And (verse 30) he named the place Peniel, for I have “seen God face to face” and my life is preserved! “The man he wrestled with was God veiled in flesh; pointing out Christ would wrestle with that seed to bless it”! Also the elect has wrestled with God for a blessing, now they will see Him working personally, like face to face in the spirit! “And all those who cross my platform who believe Christ is standing beside me, their seed will be preserved like Jacob’s!” He is getting ready to do great things here! Believe!!

THE FACE OF JESUS— Isa. 53:2 gives a perfect description of Him. “He hath no form nor comeliness, and when we shall see Him there is no beauty that we should desire him.” He wanted the Jews to look upon Him as “a spiritual” and not “a physical” attraction! This is the way He appeared to them in the Holy Land! Also Isa. 52:14 says, many were astonied at Him. His visage was marred more than any man and His form more than the sons of men.” In other words His pre-looks were veiled! (Also His face over our Temple was like it was when He appeared to Israel! (Luke 19:41, 42) — “But when we see Him coming in glory He will be like Peter, James and John saw!” (Luke 9:28, 29) “They saw the skin veil lifted and His countenance (face) was altered, and His raiment was white and glistering! Daniel and John saw another description of God’s face as the Almighty! (Rev. 4:3) And this one is like the corner Headstone you saw in the new book (pages 166, 206) At His death “the veil of the Temple was broken”, and after death His body that was broken and pierced was mended back together, and His Church has been split and broken and now He is going to mend it back together through His message! (Matt 27:51-53)

LIGHTS OVER CAPSTONE— THE CAPTAIN WITH HIS HOST! — Beautiful “rose fire” lights were photographed over the Temple just before I spoke on the 7th. Seal! The Lord confirmed by prophecy that these beautiful lights settled over the Temple to baptize it as His spiritual Holy place! “Then the lights lifted up from the building and rested over the Headstone as a golden glory fell over the face of it, giving to it the appearance of a crystal look, Magnificent!” We might say that on the begining date so much power was in the building that the sound would not function properly! The sound technician said it was caused from a power unseen and not of this world! It was “the fiery wheels of the Almighty” as He passed over Capstone confirming it His place! Bringing our attention to the “SOUND.” (Rev. 10:7) — “Also on the final day of the meeting another remarkable sign occurred, the Lord’s burning bush which definitely resembles the pillar of fire or “was the pillar of fire’ was photographed in color! “Tt gave the circle appearance of a sparkling, bright, golden, amber fire, incredible, sir can I say again incredible!” We allowed witnesses to describe the picture, as they saw it from the platform. A crippled woman whom God dissolved a 7 inch metal plate in her leg said it was amazing! A man in whom God created a new stomach said it was wonderful to look upon, others described it as God’s sign! So the meeting started and closed with God’s dramatic signs! “Hear ye the Word of the Lord and I shall even do mightier things in the future!” We will release these pictures and even the unbeliever will have to say truly God is in this place! Ezek. 10:4, 5, 19, (wheels, read scrs. 46, 47)

SCIENCE REPORTS PLANET CLUSTER VISIBLE— Just before the opening of our revival a mysterious gathering took place of bright heavenly lights, just West of Capstone in the very vicinity of the “Headstone” mountains! The paper described it as a triple conjunction of lights, a rare phenomena of our time! — Also it was denoted that 5 heavenly bodies were in one constellation during our meeting! — “So God allowed Science to record that a great event was to take place upon the earth, and it was the opening of our meeting!”’ Praise Him! (Gen 1:14 — Luke 21:25)

ANCIENT TEMPLE SCROLL DISCOVERED— Time Magazine several years ago published an article entitled the Temple Scroll, which was confiscated in the recaptured Old City of Jerusalem. The parchment was in extremely fragile condition, but could be very important. The scroll was supposed to give precise specifications for the building of the Jewish temple. Whether the Jews use this as a guide we do not know yet, but we know they will build soon. (Also we see scrolls were involved in the building of Capstone, showing the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled!) Our Gentile Temple points prophetically that the Jewish Temple will be built soon! (Rev. 11) The rise of the anti-christ is near, promising peace in this age of wars and rumors of wars! (Also we may point out that these lights seen over Capstone will appear over the Holy Land about the time He returns to Israel, His anointed seed!

WORLD EVENTS— We are seeing changes in China, Pakistan and India. Rome has been involved in the new monetary crisis. All of a sudden we have seen and will see unusal changes! They are preparing a new money system and they are getting ready for future world trade as the merchants of Babylon are rising heavily upon the scene! Pray, watch!

The Lord told me and we know the ones who deny His work and this message do not have their names on the Book of Life and others denying it will go through the Tribulation. “Behold I am the stone by which the destinies of men are forever settled, and whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken, but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder. (Matt. 21:44)” For these be the Words of the living God, take not this scroll lightly for it is woven in My hand
